name: Tip Calculator
description: Calculate a tip amount and split the total bill evenly between any number of people, with quick presets for common tip percentages.

faq.question: Does this tip on the pre-tax or post-tax total?
faq.answer: Whatever you enter as the bill amount — this tool doesn't separate tax from the bill automatically. In the US, tipping on the pre-tax subtotal is the more common convention; enter that amount if you want to follow it.

faq.question: How does splitting work with an uneven number of people?
faq.answer: The total (bill + tip) is divided evenly across everyone entered — it doesn't account for people ordering different amounts. For itemized splitting where everyone pays for what they actually ordered, you'd need to total each person's items separately first.
